_comment: Theme definition. Filename stem (here: 'my_theme') becomes part of the
theme id — this file is loaded as '_replace_:my_theme'. Rename both the
folder ('_replace_') AND this file's stem to whatever suits your pack;
then point data/_replace_/neoorigins/active_theme.json at the new id.
Every field below is OPTIONAL. Missing fields keep the built-in
'neoorigins:parchment' defaults — you can ship a JSON containing just
the colours you want to tweak.
Colour fields are ARGB hex strings (alpha first, then RGB). '#'-prefixed
panel_background, font: resource locations into your own (or any) namespace.
panel.png should be 256x256 with a transparent margin / 12 px border
used by the 9-slice. If your texture is a different size, override
